title: Flower and Song (In Xochitl In Cuicatl) & Rooted Truth
summary: The foundational Nahua epistemological and aesthetic doctrine articulated by Nezahualcoyotl. On the transient, slippery earth (tlalticpac), ordinary discursive speech and empirical perception cannot grasp ultimate reality; only through in xochitl in cuicatl (flower and song: metaphor, poetry, and art) can human beings achieve rooted truth (neltiliztli) and brief, transcendent communion with the divine.
